clips.action: User pulls out a second inner packet/tube of biscuits from the multipack plastic.
clips.narration: Pick up the second packaging of biscuits from the multi-package plastics, holding the multi-package plastic with the right hand and the inner package with the left hand and pulling it out.

clips.action: User discards a biscuit into the food waste bin (thrown away).
clips.narration: throw this biscuit into the bin as it probably has fallen into part of the countertop that's not so clean.

clips.action: User separates the cut slice from the rest of the butter block.
clips.narration: Push the cut part using the knife to separate it from the rest of the butter. As the knife has not sliced the butter fully, this additional force causes the slice to separate from the soft butter.

clips.action: User places the butter package back onto the second shelf of the fridge.
clips.narration: Place the butter's package on the second shelf left side using the left hand.

clips.action: User unwraps/unfolds the foil packaging around the chicken stock cube.
clips.narration: Open the cover of the chicken cube by unfolding the sides of the cover, holding the cube with the left hand and unfolding the sides with the right hand. All four sides.

clips.action: User drops the chicken stock cube into the mug with hot water.
clips.narration: Drop the chicken cube inside the mug with hot water to melt it forming some stock using the left hand.

clips.action: User opens/unfolds the foil packaging around the chicken stock cube.
clips.narration: open the stock cubes packaging by holding the cube with the left hand and unfolding the foil packaging around it with the right hand.

clips.action: User removes the chicken stock cube from the foil packaging.
clips.narration: hold the foil packaging with the left hand and remove the stock cube from inside the packaging using the right hand.

clips.action: User throws the chicken stock cube into the pot.
clips.narration: Throw the stock cube into the pot with water, carrots and onion to season the soup.

clips.action: User throws a handful of flour from the bag onto the dough mix.
clips.narration: Throw the handful of flour onto the dough mix. The dough is too wet, thus decreasing its wetness.

clips.action: Pour the contents of the bowl (water, yeast, and sugar) into the bigger bowl with flour and oil, transferring the sugar into the mixture.
clips.narration: Pour the content of the bowl into the bigger bowl with flour and oil, thus adding water, yeast and sugar into the mixture. These are the wet components of the dough.

clips.action: Tip the bowl upside down to ensure any remaining liquid (including dissolved sugar) fully drains into the bigger bowl.
clips.narration: Move the bowl upside down to ensure all the water inside it drop.

clips.action: Pour the measured sumac from the lid into the pan.
clips.narration: Pour the measured sumac from the lid into the pan by turning the lid upside down on top of the pan so the sumac falls from the lid into the pan. Pour the sumac on top of the tahini, yogurt and the cooked meat.

clips.action: Shake the lid over the pan to drop remaining sumac into the pan.
clips.narration: Shake the lid on top of the pan to drop any of the remaining spice from it into the pan.

clips.action: Loosen the tahini jar lid by rotating it counterclockwise.
clips.narration: Switch the hands by holding the jar with the right hand and the lid with the left hand. And now try to rotate the jar clockwise with the right hand and the lid counterclockwise with the left hand, adding more force. This is a successful attempt and the lid indeed loosens.

clips.action: Add the spoonful of tahini into the pan on top of the meat and yogurt.
clips.narration: Pour the spoonful of tahini on top of the meat and yogurt.

clips.action: Add the additional tahini into the pan.
clips.narration: Pour the additional tahini on the pan.

clips.action: Add the spoonful of tahini into the pan (shaking the spoon to release it).
clips.narration: Pour the handful of tahini into the pan, shaking the spoon firmly to drop the content into the pan.

clips.action: Lift the plate covering the bowl of yeast (fermenting mixture) to check fermentation progress.
clips.narration: Lift the plate that's covering the bowl of yeast to check the progress of the yeast fermentation.
